items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: We had two cars driven by a couple of wild Lexington fellows

ctx.x: From Cincy we went to Lexington where we played one week for the fair and it really jumped. Came back to Cincy and played at the Crystal Ballroom and then went to Louisville, Ky., I had been there a few times with Helvey but this was the first time with Lloyd.

We had two cars driven by a couple of wild Lexington fellows and we went through a certain part of Indiana before crossing this river to the Kentucky side. As we were going along a very wide dirt road these two drivers started racing. The car I was in passed the other one and then the other one would

pass us. This went on for a few miles until finally as we were about to pass the other car again, the other driver made a manoeuver as if he was coming over to the left side of the road to cut us off and our driver pulled over to the left at the same time and our car went over on the side in a ditch.
